notes:
{松|まつ} refers to pine trees, evergreen conifers symbolic of longevity and good fortune in Japanese culture.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Pine is one of the "Three Friends of Winter" (⟦{松竹梅|しょうちくばい}→松竹梅：19391_shouchikubai⟧: pine, bamboo, plum), representing endurance and good fortune.
